name: qlrisk_pnl_explain
title: P&L explain
description: Explain a book's P&L between two market states: actual full-revaluation P&L per trade split into theta (time decay), per-risk-class and per-factor Taylor contributions, and the unexplained remainder. The end state is end_market_data, or the start market plus end_shocks, and end_valuation_date for the time roll. Example: {"trades": [...], "end_shocks": [{"factor": "EQ.SPX", "size": -0.05, "shock_type": "relative"}], "end_valuation_date": "2026-10-12"}.
